lectures.title: Using the Service with Dependency Injection

cues.en: With the service set up, we want to use it in our components and let's start by using it in our personal
component, which is where we need to do list of persons.
We don't need to add a buying double property here anymore so we can get rid of that.
And instead, here, I'll just add a person list again, actually, which is an array of strings, but
it's not bendable with at input.
But I know when I get my data from the person service and for that we use that feature called dependency
injection, which I mentioned before.
We need to tell Angella which dependencies this component has.
And we're not doing this through import statements or anything like this because all of these will be
removed in our built step.
Remember all that gets compiled and merged together.
So that's not something angular can read when the code executes.
Instead, we add a constructor here to our class.
That's a built in function that will run automatically whenever Angular creates a new instance of this
component.
So essentially, whenever it starts creating the component for rendering.
In this constructor, we can accept arguments, and since we will never instantiate this class on our
own, but Angela will do this, it's angler's job to give us all the arguments we expect here.
Now, of course, ANGULAR will fail to do so if you want to get anything arbitrary here, but it will
succeed if we expect something which is injectable, like our prisons service.
So here I can now get, for example, my press service.
That name is up to you.
But important here is that you now add a type definition, which is persons' service, and you need
to import that from your person service file.
Otherwise, TypeScript doesn't find that type.
Now, Angular will actually be able to now resolve this service by that type.
It will look, if it finds this type, if it knows how to create an object based on that type and it
is able to do so because you marked this class, which automatically also acts as a type with injectable.
So this is how dependency injection works.
And now person service is made available here only in the constructor, though.
Now what we can do now is we can set this person list so this property of this class equal to person
service persons here.
So our list of persons we have in the service, if you do that and save everything, you will see your
list of persons again.
